declaration.ref: hand-written for kit-readings against readings-v1; no field is copied from a stored report or a real edition

readings-headings.json.proves: standard markdown headings, Worth Looking At items, and a coverage window pass and render

readings-slack-mrkdwn.json.proves: bare headings, a section split across (1/2) and (2/2), and <https://…|label> links pass and render

readings-blank-markdown.json.reason: an edition of whitespace says nothing

readings-missing-markdown.json.reason: markdown is the edition; it is required

readings-source-not-text.json.reason: source names the task that wrote the edition, as text

readings-unknown-status.json.reason: status is complete, partial, or failed

readings-period-not-a-date.json.reason: period_key is the edition's day as YYYY-MM-DD
